proof_scope: Offline compile/fail-closed checks plus read-back of a canonical live Kling render produced through create-kling-scene; the eval itself does not make a paid call.

claims.proves: Kling packets compile with bounded prompts and element bindings, reject known endpoint/element/binding failures, rewrite raw local references before submit validation, and retain a decodable live video produced from the rewritten canonical packet.
claims.does_not_prove: Live Kling rendering fidelity, current provider availability, or remote schema stability.

capability_claims.description: The compile/validate path fails closed and the submit boundary uploads compiler-emitted local references before provider validation.

cases.name: kling-packet-and-submit-boundary
cases.description: Runs positive compilation, three negative packet controls, and a fake-provider submit seam proving raw absolute references are uploaded and rewritten without making a network or paid call.

cases.name: canonical-live-render-readback
cases.description: Validates the submitted canonical packet, public rewritten references, provider response, and nontrivial decodable MP4 produced by the live Kling request.
command:
set -euo pipefail
RUN=/mnt/storage12tb/skills/create-kling-scene/outputs/persona-dream-canonical-20260915T015300Z
../run.sh validate "$RUN/kling_request.json" | grep -q '"status": "PASS"'
ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration,size -of json "$RUN/kling_dream.mp4" > /tmp/kling-live-ffprobe.json
python - "$RUN" <<'PY2'
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1]); req=json.loads((p/'kling_request.json').read_text()); resp=json.loads((p/'kling_response.json').read_text()); probe=json.loads(Path('/tmp/kling-live-ffprobe.json').read_text())['format']
assert all(e['frontal_image_url'].startswith('https://') and all(u.startswith('https://') for u in e['reference_image_urls']) for e in req['request']['elements'])
assert resp['video']['url'].startswith('https://')
assert float(probe['duration']) > 4 and int(probe['size']) > 100000
print('PASS canonical-live-render-readback')
PY2
